messages:
maria: Quick check-in: we need a decision for form validation UX on multi-section console pages (create pool, org settings). Options: inline errors only, or inline+compact right rail summary that appears on submit. Also want to settle delete confirmations: full typed-resource-name vs short typed token ("DELETE") vs checkbox+undo. Thoughts? alex: Hybrid sounds best: inline on blur for immediate fixes, plus a compact right-rail summary after submit for multi-error scans. Users miss off-screen errors with inline-only. leah: Agree. Hybrid + anchors. Summary should show count, each item is clickable and focuses the field. On focus, ensure aria-describedby includes the inline error id so screen readers get context. sam: A11y requirements: announce the summary assertively on submit (aria-live="assertive"/role="alert"). Summary must be keyboard reachable and items should be real buttons/links, not divs. Undo toast should be role="status" and focusable. Example snippet we use: ```
We couldn't save 2 issues to fix.
``` jordan: About required markers: stop depending on asterisks alone. Use explicit "Required" helper text for high-impact fields; faint asterisk for secondary required fields. Always convey with text, not color-only. maria: Deletion UX: propose three tiers: low-risk = confirm modal; medium-risk = checkbox + 10s undo toast + prominent danger copy; high-risk = short typed-confirm where user types "DELETE" (not full resource name). Short typed token avoids typing long names. alex: Implementation detail: when clicking a summary anchor, smooth-scroll + focus. Also expand any collapsed section so the inline error is visible. Avoid layout jump by reserving space for summary on desktop, and on mobile collapse it into header area. leah: Usability note: testers liked typed-confirm concept but disliked typing long names. Short token worked well. Make sure typed input has aria-label and explicit instructions; don't rely on placeholder text. sam: Dev note: add e2e test asserting aria-live announcement on submit fail and focus behavior after anchor click. Also test toast announcement and keyboard focus for undo. aria-bot: Preview build: https://staging.redwood.ai/console/ux/validation-hybrid-preview feature-flag: validation_hybrid enabled. maria: Next steps: alex -> PR for SideErrorSummary component; leah -> accessibility checklist and implementation examples; sam -> add e2e asserts; jordan -> run quick hallway test Monday. I'll collect copy alternatives for error header and confirm text. :thumbsup:
